story_beats.title: HOLY MEN AND UNPAID BILLS
story_beats.line: On a Visakhapatnam street, a bairagi troupe performs holiness while a shopkeeper chases unpaid toddy debts, and gossip names a village case about a girl and false witnesses. The satire sits on fraud, rumor, and men's panic about careers. The missing girl is not a collectible the player can recover for points.

Refuse to turn a legal scare into a rescue fantasy
choice_responses: Comedy belongs to unpaid bills and borrowed holiness. The girl's safety is not a punchline.
Gossip may point at a case without proving it. This stop does not invent a verdict.
